Support

Kontaro Support

Need help with the Kontaro app for iPhone and Android, the web app or your account? We’re here.

Contact us

Email talk@kontaro.ai. We reply within 1 business day (Monday to Friday). Please write from your account’s email address and tell us your company name, your phone model and what happened, so we can help faster.

Frequently asked questions

How do I sign in to the Kontaro app?

Open the Kontaro app on your iPhone or Android phone and sign in with the same email and password you use on the Kontaro web app (relay.kontaro.ai). If you don’t have an account yet, create one for free on kontaro.ai. If you can’t sign in, email talk@kontaro.ai from your account’s email address and we’ll help.

How do I connect WhatsApp?

The workspace owner or an admin connects WhatsApp in the Kontaro web app (relay.kontaro.ai) with the guided Facebook login, which uses Meta’s official WhatsApp Business Platform. We recommend doing this on a computer. Once the number is connected, its conversations appear in the mobile app automatically.

How do I turn notifications on or off?

In the app, go to Settings → This device and switch notifications on or off. This only changes the phone you are using. You can also allow or block Kontaro notifications in your phone’s own settings.

How does the Face ID or fingerprint lock work?

You can lock the app with Face ID, Touch ID or your fingerprint in Settings → This device. The check is done by your phone’s operating system: Kontaro never receives your face or fingerprint data, only whether the lock is on or off on that device.

How do I delete my account?

In the app or the web app, go to Settings → Privacy & legal → Delete my account, enter your password and confirm. You can also email us. See how to delete your Kontaro account for what is deleted and what may be kept.

Where do I manage my plan and billing?

Plans, payments and invoices are managed on the website, not in the mobile apps. Sign in at relay.kontaro.ai in a browser to choose or change a plan. Payments are processed by Stripe. The apps don’t sell subscriptions or offer in-app purchases.
